purpose: Visual concepts for choosing a style, not an implemented UI or authoritative map

variants.name: Светлый GIS
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished, realistic desktop web-app interface concept, wide landscape 16:10, edge-to-edge UI with no device frame, no surrounding presentation board. This is a visual style option for an existing Russian urban-planning and pedestrian accessibility application "ОБНИНСК 2040". Use the attached district PLAN strictly as a GEOGRAPHY REFERENCE for the map content only: north-south main avenue slightly left of center of the mapped area, a small roundabout in the lower portion, a parallel eastern street, green triangular plaza upper-right of the main avenue, roughly 41 mostly long low/midrise apartment footprints. Transform it into an elegant shallow-isometric 3D planning map. Retain its broad district arrangement and modest buildings; do not copy the plan poster's framing, title, legend or footer. It is a design concept, not a survey map.
Keep the same usable interface structure across all style options: a slim full-width top bar with the brand, two understated navigation links "Конструктор" and "Сценарии", and a right-aligned "Сохранить" button. Left sidebar about 22% of screen width, calm and compact, headed "Объекты на карте", small subtitle "Центр Обнинска". Three-tab selector "Разместить", "Объекты", "Анализ", first tab active. A labelled category dropdown "Тип объекта" with value "Остановка", walking profile dropdown "Пешком", one primary button "Поставить на карте", a short hint "Выберите точку на дорожке", then collapsed rows "Результат размещения" and "Параметры расчёта". Plenty of breathing room, no long prose, no bulky dashboard cards. Map occupies all remaining space, detailed walkways, restrained trees and soft shadows; show a few green pedestrian edges and one short thick orange/red busy section, and a clear selected stop marker. Small map controls "3D / План", "До / После", a right-side vertical zoom/layers toolbar. Show a small low-key "Визуальный концепт" label at the lower edge. Russian typography must be clean and readable, use short exact labels only. No "Локальный проект", no "О модели", no large legend box, no fake numerical accessibility claims, no decorative charts, no promotional slogans, no futuristic towers, no large glow or gaming aesthetics. This is a serious implemented-looking map analysis tool with carefully designed spacing, hierarchy and readable controls. Distinguish the style strongly, not merely a minor recolor.

Visual direction 1 — LIGHT GIS MINIMALISM. At the top left of the complete image include the small clear identifier '01 · Светлый GIS'. Crisp white #FFFFFF panels, cool light-gray #F1F4F7 map ground, near-black graphite #202937 text, restrained saturated blue #2563EB primary interactions, pale blue selected states. White/gray 3D extruded buildings with delicate clean edges; muted sage green landscaping; no warm beige UI. Fine dividers, 6px corner radii, precise contemporary sans-serif typography, restrained compact outlines, professional scientific mapping product. Top bar white with a thin gray lower rule, no dark header. Blue active tab and primary action; large uncluttered map.
